title: Synthesis and Development of Novel Small-Molecule MEIS2 Inhibitors That Induce Cell Death in Breast Cancer Cells by Targeting the Homeobox Domain.
authors: Kocabas, Fatih; Girgin, Birkan; Uslu, Merve; Siyah, Pinar; Mermer, Arif
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接筛选MEIS2同源域小分子抑制剂并验证其抑癌效果，虽涉及TF-DNA结合位点（TGACAG）和对接方法，但核心是药物开发而非TF-DNA互作机制建模，方法深度有限。
abstract: Background: MEIS proteins are essential homeobox transcription factors that play critical roles in development and have been increasingly implicated in oncogenesis, including breast cancer. Methods: In this study, we identified and characterized novel small-molecule MEIS2 inhibitors through in silico docking targeting the active region of the human MEIS2 homeobox domain. Lead candidates MEISi-2E, MEISi-3, and MEISi-4 were identified with binding energies ranging from -3.0 to -3.90 kcal/mol. The inhibitory potential of these molecules was validated in vitro using a species-conserved MEIS-Luciferase Reporter construct containing the TGACAG targeted locus. Results: Our results demonstrate that MEISi-2E, MEISi-3, and MEISi-4 significantly suppress MEIS-driven luciferase activity and downregulate the expression of Meis1, Meis2, and downstream genes such as IL17RB, CDH1, EGR2, PAX6, and SERPINE1 while upregulating negative regulator TGIF1 and SOX3. In breast cancer cell lines, these inhibitors exhibited potent growth inhibition, with MEISi-3 showing an exceptional IC50 as low as 0.1 muM in SK-BR-3 cells. Mechanistic studies using flow cytometry revealed that these inhibitors induce dose-dependent apoptosis and necrosis. Importantly, the novel inhibitors showed minimal toxicity to healthy human dermal and MRC5 fibroblasts, suggesting a favorable safety profile. Conclusions: These findings establish these small molecules as promising therapeutic candidates for targeting MEIS2-dependent pathways in breast cancer.
abstract_zh: 背景：MEIS蛋白是重要的同源盒转录因子，在发育中发挥关键作用，并日益被发现在包括乳腺癌在内的肿瘤发生中具有重要功能。方法：在本研究中，我们通过针对人MEIS2同源盒结构域活性区域的计算机模拟对接，识别并表征了新型小分子MEIS2抑制剂。候选先导化合物MEISi-2E、MEISi-3和MEISi-4的结合能范围为-3.0至-3.90 kcal/mol。这些分子的抑制潜力通过使用含有TGACAG靶向位点的物种保守MEIS-荧光素酶报告基因构建体在体外得到验证。结果：我们的结果表明，MEISi-2E、MEISi-3和MEISi-4显著抑制MEIS驱动的荧光素酶活性，并下调Meis1、Meis2及下游基因如IL17RB、CDH1、EGR2、PAX6和SERPINE1的表达，同时上调负调控因子TGIF1和SOX3。在乳腺癌细胞系中，这些抑制剂表现出强效的生长抑制作用，其中MEISi-3在SK-BR-3细胞中的IC50低至0.1 μM。使用流式细胞术的机制研究表明，这些抑制剂诱导剂量依赖性的细胞凋亡和坏死。重要的是，这些新型抑制剂对健康人真皮成纤维细胞和MRC5成纤维细胞显示出极低的毒性，提示其具有良好的安全性特征。结论：这些发现确立了这些小分子作为靶向乳腺癌中MEIS2依赖性通路的有前景的治疗候选药物。
